metadata.question: Does the ocean surface brightness in the Black Sea increase in June 20, 2022 compared to May 20, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need ocean surface brightness data for Black Sea - Two specific dates: May 20, 2022 and June 20, 2022 - Sentinel-2 (for surface reflectance) or MODIS ocean color products could work - Will use Sentinel-2 as it has good coverage and resolution - Define Black Sea geometry (approximate center region) 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want clear ocean surface brightness - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking - Also ensure we're only looking at water pixels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid brightness values should be in reasonable range (0-1 for reflectance) - If no images found for either date → C1 - If images exist but all masked out → C2 - If calculation returns null/NaN → C3 - Compare mean brightness values between the two dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Black Sea geometry (central region) const blackSea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[30.0, 41.0], [42.0, 41.0], [42.0, 46.5], [30.0, 46.5], [30.0, 41.0]] ]); // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get data for May 20, 2022 (±3 days window) let mayCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(blackSea) .filterDate('2022-05-18', '2022-05-23') .map(maskClouds); let maySize = await mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May images found: ${maySize}`); // Fallback to wider date range if needed if (maySize === 0) { mayCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(blackSea) .filterDate('2022-05-15', '2022-05-25') .map(maskClouds); maySize = await mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May images (wider range): ${maySize}`); } // 4. Get data for June 20, 2022 (±3 days window) let juneCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(blackSea) .filterDate('2022-06-18', '2022-06-23') .map(maskClouds); let juneSize = await juneCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June images found: ${juneSize}`); // Fallback to wider date range if needed if (juneSize === 0) { juneCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(blackSea) .filterDate('2022-06-15', '2022-06-25') .map(maskClouds); juneSize = await juneCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June images (wider range): ${juneSize}`); } if (maySize === 0 || juneSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean brightness (use visible bands B2,B3,B4) const mayImg = mayCol.median().select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']); const juneImg = juneCol.median().select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']); // Calculate mean brightness as average of RGB bands const mayBrightness = mayImg.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()); const juneBrightness = juneImg.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()); // 6. Check pixel counts const mayCount = await mayBrightness.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: blackSea, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2_mean').getInfo(); const juneCount = await juneBrightness.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: blackSea, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2_mean').getInfo(); console.log(`May valid pixels: ${mayCount}, June valid pixels: ${juneCount}`); if (mayCount === 0 || juneCount === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Get mean values const mayVal = await mayBrightness.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: blackSea, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2_mean').getInfo(); const juneVal = await juneBrightness.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: blackSea, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2_mean').getInfo(); console.log(`May brightness: ${mayVal}, June brightness: ${juneVal}`); // 8. Validate and answer if (mayVal === null || juneVal === null || isNaN(mayVal) || isNaN(juneVal)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (mayVal < 0 || juneVal < 0 || mayVal > 10000 || juneVal > 10000) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (juneVal > mayVal) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
